design: Evaluate the original, six globally lowest, and six spatially stratified reference cells frozen from the 4 arcmin SHASSA selection. Remeasure the same 14 chronological 180 s darks, with Bayer green pair and the exact frozen science support; keep 15th dark untouched. For each layout and each of mean and median, compare all unique balanced splits. Propagate the six-cell difference through a planar fit to the three fixed 2 ADU digital profiles, using aperture flux and relative L2; report interleaving and chronological split explicitly. Reproduce the original dark values and endpoint results. Quantiles are descriptive on reused frames. No independent optical truth or H-alpha to ADU conversion.
